_doc: Asset manifest fragment for the Bishop line (spec #372 #373). The 3rd and 4th job Cleric skill books Skill.wz/231.img (Priest) and 232.img (Bishop) whole, and the Sound.wz/Skill.img nodes of the Bishop pool skills that no other fragment lists: Shining Ray 2311004, Summon Dragon 2311006, Big Bang 2321001, Bahamut 2321003, Resurrection 2321006, Angel Ray 2321007 and Genesis 2321008. 2321001 Use/Loop are UOLs to the F/P nodes 2121001 (magician.json); the importer exports the skill under its own node name. Skill.wz/200.img and 230.img (Magic Claw, Teleport, Heal, Holy Arrow), their sounds and Effect.wz/BasicEff.img/Teleport are in magician.json; the Holy Symbol common-passive icons come from Skill.wz/910.img in common.json.
